text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"The level of formal computer science or closely related technical education stated in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree as the candidate's highest formal education."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree plus some additional structured technical study or credentialing, but no advanced degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree in computer science or a closely related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree and also signals unusually advanced or research-style technical preparation beyond a typical master's."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctoral degree in computer science or a closely related technical field."}]},{"name":"Professional software delivery depth","description":"The extent of hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows early-career production experience with only a few years of work and limited breadth of launched or maintained services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear qualifying production experience, but the scope of systems owned or launched remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid mid-level depth through multiple production services and a clear mix of testing, maintenance, and launch work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong production depth through either longer tenure or ownership of a larger number of production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows extensive production depth over many years and several launched services, suggesting strong readiness to contribute immediately."}]},{"name":"Programming language breadth","description":"The breadth of practical programming experience across languages beyond the role's core requirements.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows Go plus only a very small set of additional languages, suggesting limited language breadth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows Go plus a few other languages, indicating some adaptability beyond a single stack."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows practical comfort across several languages, suggesting solid multi-language flexibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows broad experience across many languages used in varied engineering contexts."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows very broad language breadth and makes it clear the candidate uses different languages deliberately for different layers or tasks."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"The strength of evidence that the candidate can build production back-end systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go but gives little indication that it is a central implementation language for the candidate."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as regular experience, but not clearly as one of the candidate's strongest production languages."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a primary or frequently used language in production work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter makes clear that Go is the candidate's daily driver or chief language for production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter positions Go as a major strength and ties it to concrete back-end or systems work that closely matches the role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"The strength of evidence that the candidate can build substantial Python tooling, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not give meaningful evidence of Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python briefly, but gives little detail about how it is used or at what level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows Python as a regular working language for tooling, automation, services, or analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows extensive production use of Python across multiple purposes such as services, pipelines, tooling, or automation layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a production-grade strength and backs that up with concrete examples of robust services, tooling, or agents built in it."}]},{"name":"Backend and infrastructure engineering depth","description":"The depth of experience with back-end services, infrastructure, distributed systems, or foundational platform engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little evidence beyond generic software development, with no clear signs of systems or infrastructure depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions back-end or service work, but the technical complexity of that work remains unclear or limited."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly shows experience building or operating back-end services or infrastructure systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong systems depth through complex back-end, distributed, or infrastructure work in professional roles or serious projects."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly demonstrates deep engineering of foundational, distributed, or reliability-sensitive systems that closely match the role's back-end focus."}]},{"name":"Operational reliability mindset","description":"The extent to which the letter shows a maintainer's mindset focused on correctness, operability, resilience, and long-term stewardship.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses mainly on building features and gives little sense of a maintenance, testing, or reliability orientation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions maintenance or testing, but treats them mostly as checklist items rather than as an engineering mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a clear appreciation for production correctness, maintenance, or reliable operation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly frames the candidate as a maintainer who values operability, quiet reliability, and systems others can safely inherit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter strongly foregrounds a stewardship mindset, using concrete examples or philosophy that prioritize resilience, correctness, and long-term ownership."}]},{"name":"Data structures and algorithms strength","description":"The strength of evidence of practical algorithmic skill relevant to performance, indexing, scheduling, correlation, or systems design.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no meaningful evidence of data structures or algorithms ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims general comfort with algorithms, but offers no concrete example of applying that skill."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one concrete example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a real system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful technical depth by applying algorithms or structure choice to a demanding systems problem such as hot paths, deduplication, graphs, or streaming work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents algorithmic skill as a clear strength and ties it to solving a technically difficult problem with obvious practical impact."}]},{"name":"Applied AI engineering experience","description":"The strength of evidence of building and shipping AI or LLM-backed functionality responsibly in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention any relevant AI or model-backed engineering experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI in broad terms, but does not provide a concrete production use case or responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the candidate has shipped model-backed or LLM-based functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows practical judgment about AI reliability, evaluation, predictability, or failure modes in production use."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial applied AI experience that combines shipped systems with clear attention to trustworthiness, evaluation, and operational constraints."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"The strength of evidence of designing agents or agentic tooling with clear control boundaries and supporting infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of agentic systems or AI-agent architecture experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references agents only vaguely, without architectural detail or clear personal ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the candidate has built agentic systems or pipelines end to end."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains a concrete agent architecture, such as Python agents paired with Go services, bounded tasks, permissions, logging, or auditability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep design judgment about agentic systems by emphasizing autonomy within explicit controls and connecting that architecture directly to scaling security work."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability-response automation","description":"The strength of evidence of building tooling that automates vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or variant analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of direct work on automating vulnerability handling or report processing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in security automation, but provides no past example of building it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes having built tooling for vulnerability triage or report handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows that the tooling automated meaningful steps such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or self-serve handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes a substantial vulnerability-response automation system and makes its relevance to scale, expert workload, or fleet-wide protection very clear."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"The strength of evidence of performing structured security assessments such as threat modeling, code review, design review, or fix validation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not present any direct evidence of security assessment experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies security interest or exposure, but does not clearly describe assessment work performed by the candidate."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states that the candidate has conducted security assessments or reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete assessment activities such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or validation of remediations."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents security assessment as a practiced capability with a clear method and a builder's understanding of where design assumptions fail in implementation."}]},{"name":"Security mindset","description":"The extent to which the letter shows attacker-oriented thinking and a rigorous philosophy about building security-sensitive software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter treats security mostly as a keyword match and shows little distinctive security thinking."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows generic interest in security, but not a clear point of view about how secure engineering should be done."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a recognizable security perspective, such as valuing secure defaults, reduced incidents, or stronger engineering standards."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter articulates a strong security philosophy grounded in attacker thinking, rigorous standards, or quiet resilience."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows an especially mature security mindset by combining attacker perspective, engineering rigor, and a clear view of security as systemic risk reduction."}]},{"name":"Foundational platform orientation","description":"The extent to which the letter shows interest in central platform or infrastructure work whose benefits compound across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows little or no interest in shared platform, foundational tooling, or central infrastructure work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions scale or back-end work broadly, but does not clearly value the leverage of foundation teams."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some appreciation for central tooling or infrastructure used by other engineers or teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values foundational work because improvements there compound across many teams or products."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents platform leverage as a core career motivation and directly ties past work or desired impact to organization-wide foundational systems."}]},{"name":"Understanding of the team's problem space","description":"How well the letter demonstrates insight into the specific challenges of security automation, vulnerability handling, and AI-enabled tooling at Google's scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could fit many generic software roles and shows little awareness of this team's specific mission."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security or automation broadly, but only lightly connects to the posted responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly connects to the team's mandate through themes such as secure defaults, vulnerability handling, or internal tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong role-specific insight through ideas such as scaling scarce security judgment, variant analysis, bounded agents, or organization-wide leverage."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates nuanced understanding of the job as a systems problem at Google scale and connects the candidate's background directly to those exact challenges."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"The extent to which the letter shows a desire to help other engineers do the secure thing by default through low-friction tooling and workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses mainly on the candidate's own technical interests and gives little sense of enabling other engineers."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions helping teams in general terms, but shows limited empathy for developer workflows or friction."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values making security easier for developer teams through tooling, defaults, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter emphasizes reducing friction, increasing team capacity, or building tools close to their users."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter strongly centers developer enablement as the purpose of the work and shows concrete empathy for busy engineers who need the secure path to be the easy path."}]},{"name":"Cross-functional security collaboration orientation","description":"The extent to which the letter shows readiness to work closely with security specialists and internal developer stakeholders.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no meaningful evidence of collaborating with security specialists or internal developer stakeholders."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter uses generic teamwork language or says the candidate wants to learn from others, but gives no concrete collaboration context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives some indication of working with service owners, teammates, or internal users on shared tooling or reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides clear evidence of partnering with security or developer teams to assess systems, build tools, or roll out workflows."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes collaboration central to the candidate's fit, showing that they already build security automation in close partnership with the specialists and developers it serves."}]},{"name":"Motivation for the role","description":"The strength and authenticity of the candidate's stated reasons for pursuing this specific role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The motivation is generic, formulaic, or limited to restating the role title."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some interest, but the rationale remains broad and could fit many software roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives a clear and plausible reason for targeting this role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents motivation that feels personally grounded and connected to the candidate's experience, values, or career direction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a compelling and memorable reason for pursuing this role that feels specific, reflective, and strongly aligned with the work."}]},{"name":"Formal security credentialing","description":"The strength of formal security certifications or structured security credentialing presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions no formal security credential or structured security qualification."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter suggests some self-directed or structured security learning, but no recognized credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a baseline credential such as Security+ as evidence of formalized security fundamentals."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents stronger-than-baseline security credentialing or multiple structured security qualifications."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a rigorous hands-on credential such as OSCP as evidence of validated offensive security skill."}]},{"name":"Adversarial practice","description":"The strength of evidence of ongoing hands-on attacker-oriented practice through CTFs or similar exercises.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of recurring attacker-oriented practice outside routine software work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at security curiosity, but does not describe any concrete ongoing adversarial practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions occasional CTF participation or similar practice without notable depth or results."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes regular or serious adversarial practice as an ongoing way of sharpening security skills."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter cites near-top or top competitive results, or an equivalently high level of repeated attacker-oriented practice."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"The strength of contribution to or maintenance of open-source software as evidence of engineering maturity and community-facing ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention any open-source contribution or maintainership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions open source only indirectly, or shows very light engagement with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes occasional patches, fixes, or contributions to open-source projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes regular contribution or visible maintainer responsibilities for open-source software."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes sustained maintainer-level ownership of an actively used open-source project, including reviews, releases, or stewardship of contributors."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative beyond the day job","description":"The strength of evidence of self-directed technical work outside formal job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of meaningful self-directed technical work outside the candidate's job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions only a very small personal build with limited complexity or continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes a modest side project that shows follow-through and basic engineering curiosity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a technically ambitious personal project that demonstrates meaningful initiative and systems depth."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter describes a sustained, highly challenging personal project tackling difficult distributed, consistency, reliability, or infrastructure problems at a serious level."}]},{"name":"Substantiation of claims","description":"How concretely the letter backs up its claims with specific examples, technical details, and observable outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad assertions and provides little supporting evidence for its claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter names some relevant qualifications, but examples remain sparse, generic, or thin on outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter supports most major claims with at least one concrete example or specific responsibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter uses examples with real technical detail or clear outcomes that make the candidate's contribution credible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently substantiates its claims with precise, role-relevant examples and believable evidence of effect on systems or team capacity."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"The overall professionalism of the writing, including spelling, grammar, fluency, and ease of reading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent mechanical errors or awkward phrasing noticeably distract from the message and weaken credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several errors or clunky constructions are present, though the letter remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The writing is generally clear and professional, with only minor issues."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The writing is polished, fluent, and easy to read throughout."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The writing is exceptionally polished and memorable, combining clean
